items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names reveal intent (flushChunk, writeHeader, chunkPayloadLen, branchClosers). Exported functions and types have doc comments, the pipeline closer ordering is commented, and formatting follows the repo. Nothing significant is missing.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Dead wrapper `func (job *Job) validate() error { return job.Validate() }` left in. LoadKey re-runs validateFields and repeats the derive salt/passphrase checks. The decode-and-check-length code is copied across env/file/literal. Adds PathGeneratorWithEncryption instead of updating PathGenerator's callers.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Errors are wrapped with %w and ErrInvalidKey, and HMAC is compared with hmac.Equal. But `chunkData := make([]byte, chunkLen)` has no upper bound, so a bad length can force a ~4GB allocation. Magic numbers remain (100000, 16). decodeBase64 quietly accepts 4 encodings. EncryptWriter panics instead of returning an error.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: Required changes are done and unencrypted output is unchanged. Extras: PathGenerator keeps its old signature and gains a PathGeneratorWithEncryption wrapper, against the 'update callers, don't wrap' convention. Validate moved from a value to a pointer receiver. New exported constants (ChunkSize, HeaderMagic1…).
